design_hypothesis: A quiet, cool-toned mineral composition that reads restrained from a distance and richer at close range. The bracelet should rely on optical variation, asymmetric rhythm, a small structural silver intervention and one premium mineral focal zone rather than uniform bead repetition.

material_roles.boundary: premium hero candidate; may be omitted if first sample cost or visual balance is poor

structure_rules: Do not use a uniform same-size round-bead rhythm around the entire bracelet.
Keep one asymmetrical focal zone rather than a centered decorative pendant composition.
Use the curved silver tube as a structural interruption, not as a dominant luxury ornament.
Use Rainbow Moonstone as light/air, not as the only visual hero.
Aquamarine provides the main cool mineral body and visual continuity.
Larimar, if used, should be concentrated into a small hero zone rather than distributed evenly.
Maintain visible breathing space/rhythm changes through size, cut or hardware transitions instead of adding many material species.
Maximum core mineral species for P01: three. Maximum visible hardware languages: two.

prototype_variants.description: Aquamarine round body + Rainbow Moonstone light rhythm + compact Larimar hero zone + curved silver structural interruption + round silver counterweight.
prototype_variants.purpose: Test the full Glacier Signature visual thesis.

prototype_variants.description: Aquamarine round body + Rainbow Moonstone light rhythm + faceted Aquamarine transition zone + same silver hardware, without Larimar.
prototype_variants.purpose: Lower material complexity/cost fallback while preserving the Glacier structure language.

costing_rules: Do not infer per-bead cost from a strand unless seller bead count is explicitly stored.
For prototype planning, use full-strand purchase price as a conservative procurement basket cost where per-bead allocation is unavailable.
Keep VAT-included material prices, source-stated hardware prices and VAT-excluded packaging prices separated unless an explicit normalization is performed and documented.
Shipping, payment fees, wastage, tooling and returns remain unknown unless sourced.
packaging_shortlist_policy: Do not select final packaging. Compare the four exact Laval source-product benchmarks against Glacier visual fit, prototype protection and sample-order practicality; output a ranked shortlist only.
stop_boundary: Stop before any action that spends money, places an order, contacts a supplier for commitment, or locks a production supplier/quality tier/final packaging.
